Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first search result (Step 1), the WebSurfer extracted information from a GenoPro source that incorrectly stated the paternal grandparents of Prince William of Hesse-Kassel were "Prince Frederik The 2. of House Hesse-Kassel and Princess Mary of House Hanover." This is factually incorrect; the father was Prince Frederick (not Frederik II) and his mother was Princess Louise of Denmark, not Princess Mary of Hanover. The WebSurfer accepted this erroneous data from a genealogical database without sufficient cross-verification with other sources (like Wikipedia or Britannica) that correctly identified the father as Frederick and his mother as Louise. This initial error propagated through the conversation, leading to confusion between Mary of Hanover and Louise of Denmark.
